Definition: from G4183 and G5056; extremely expensive:--costly, very precious, of great price.
BiblicalUsage: Polyteles means extremely expensive, very costly. Mark uses it for the ointment of spikenard poured over Jesus, and Paul for the costly array he tells women not to wear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the contrast is the lesson: what is spent on Christ is never wasted, but display spent on ourselves is.
